note: IF sugar IN CUSTOMER SPEECH detects a positive modifier. Use WRITE 1 sugar on the held paper. New paper starts without sugar.
solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
TAKE UP
IF tea IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  ITEM tea
ELSE
  ITEM coffee
END
IF sugar IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  WRITE 1 sugar
END
MOVE RIGHT 1
DEPOSIT RIGHT
MOVE LEFT 1
JUMP listen
